summary: Cottle Knob lookout in Nicholas County, WV; the Register says the original tower was removed, and FFLA lists a standing tower moved to Pocahontas Co. H.S.

facts.status_note: Register: original tower removed. FFLA lists the site as gone, and a relocated tower standing (cab no longer in place) at Pocahontas Co. H.S.

access.note: No public access described in the sources read. The FFLA list places the tower at a school, so ask the school first

events.note: Registered September 16, 2008; nominated by Henry Isenberg
Register: 'This tower has been removed.' FFLA lists the Cottle Knob site as gone
FFLA lists a tower relocated from Cottle Knob to Pocahontas Co. H.S., with no date given

notes_for_editor: Three sources only, one of them a list. No build date, staffing or fire history in any source read; two web searches added nothing usable. The move to Pocahontas Co. H.S. rests on a single FFLA list entry with no date. Register and FFLA agree the original is gone.
